name: lyz-podcast-article
input_files: file-backed fixture: local-only 10 paired transcripts/articles; reports/corpus-index.json stores hashes, not private paths
output_contract: 默认仅一份文章.md；好奇/回答只在问答开始标记；写前全文阅读与原问计划；两份系统临时文件，成功交付后清理；不上传发布
rollback_boundary: 原文不改；已存在输出不覆盖；保留旧审计CLI兼容；通过Skills Manager可回退技能版本
network: Host agent uses read-only public research tools; packaged Python script has no network
review_policy: 每次规则变更及新增5篇实际使用后复核；最长90天
